caption:
Closing the laptop at six

"One more email." "Six. Closing." The screen went dark and nothing fell apart overnight.

The email at six past six is almost always the same one you'd answer at nine, with a fresher head.

For whoever closes the laptop at the hour they said they would.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table, a digital clock in the middle that says 5:58 and a big computer screen on the right with an inbox. A royal blue block figure with narrowed eyes says one more email. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers six. closing. The clock turns to 6:00 and the screen goes away. The blue one's eyes go wide and says ...it can wait. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me, closing at six.
